posts.body:
The era of the angels of Michael, Gabriel, Uriel and Raphael has changed, shifted and ended as we know it. 

Before entering the Akashic Records, I always take about ten minutes to set up shields, clear the space, and set protections. This protocol includes calling in the angels, not archangels. (That's a different conversation.) 

I always have called upon these four angels as part of the setup.... 

Until suddenly it wasn't. 

I opened my mouth, partway through my usual opening, to call upon them when Source interjected. 

"No," He said.

I watched as he called all four of those angels back to him instantly. They were gone. My thoughts jumped to, "Why? What's going on?" as I was startled by the abrupt shift. I hadn't expected it or anything.

Two pieces came to mind: 

1) That's Source's business. The details are not my concern. 
2) A covenant ended and those angels are no longer available. They have some discussions to do with Source among other possible changes for them. 

Apparently, the covenant kept them in the human eye for a very, very long time, but they may not have been so Source focused as we were led to believe. Something was off, through no fault of our own. 

There was something called the Michael program, for one, where humans were led to believe and feel certain things, blocking humans from truth... ironically. 

This wasn't something any human could help feeling, believing or seeing when they looked for it. 

Source sent four new angels to implement into my practice. The first was a blond angel, a male, named Stacey. 

The others were named Fernandez (male) , Borion (male) and Mongul (a female).

Stacey and Borion/Boron are incredibly powerful. It may be hard to believe, but even more powerful than Michael.  

By a lot.

A new era has emerged where Source's abundance around and within us is clearing more and more. We're getting more and more direct connection than we have for a very, very long time. 

Old covenants are lifting and leaving. Our world and our perception of reality with continue to clear and show us what's truly been going on.
posts.title: A Changing of the Guard - The Angel Michael Paradigm

posts.body:
We’ve been through many lifetimes. Sometimes millions. Sometimes more. With an eternal life, there’s no limit to how many incarnations, spanned across universes, worlds and densities, we may encounter.

So how do we recognize someone lifetime to lifetime?

Our soul was made with something called essence. Our essence is like our fingerprint. It’s unique to us as individuals. This is how we recognize someone across the millions of different appearances we may take. 

Sometimes, the connection is so strong that you'll feel it when you meet someone. You'll just click or have that feeling of, "I know you," even if they're a complete stranger in this life.

The people you come across in your life are not an accident.
posts.title: How do you Recognize Someone Lifetime to Lifetime?

posts.body:
My client had visited a sacred site when he was younger under the guise that the property was haunted since its use by the Navajo tribe.

In session, a rather large chief in full headdress came into the space. He carried himself with great respect and respect for others. Though he was serious, he was fair and wise. You could just feel it.

He clarified that his people were Cherokee, not Navajo. “We shared the land,” he explained, which my client soon confirmed after.

He explained what really had occurred on that land. They were being driven out through murder and other forces. When the last was mostly cleared the chief, the Medicine Man and another shamanic being, decided to protect the land by placing an energetic protective boundary around and within the land. Anyone who entered and wasn’t of a minimum positive frequency would be affected in a negative way. They would be bothered until such time as they began to follow the path toward the positive light, actions and choices.

And no one ever built on this part of the land.

“You are exonerated,” the chief said to my client for raising his frequency toward the good and honorable.

The chief explained that the people of their day were greedy, selfish and unkind (the ones overthrowing the land), and this wasn’t set to punish but to teach. Once a soul learned and began to grow, the “bothered”ness was lifted.

What’s interesting about this interaction is that I have repeatedly set energetic boundaries like this for clients in the Records. There have been some very grumpy souls that aren’t interested in peace or evolution still, and that’s fine – truly, but that doesn’t mean they get to cause chaos. I set this same boundary where the disgruntled soul is not allowed to interact with my client’s soul until they reach a certain frequency of peace.

This allows souls to work together in the future while maintaining a boundary in the present.

I was just fascinated to see a dynamic lift from this perspective.

Please note: I’m not saying my client is bad in any way! This is strictly a frequency-based scenario and our frequency, even as good people, can have influences outside ourselves too. Veils, implants, entities, etc. can influence our frequency too.
posts.title: Cherokee Chief Visit

posts.body:
Right before pregnancy occurs, a soul has shown interest in you as their incoming parent.

(Note: This doesn’t take away your sovereign right to choose pregnancy or not.) 

Once pregnant, the fetus begins to form as multiplying cells. The soul enters at the very first heartbeat around seven weeks gestation. Why now? 

Why not at the spark of creation -- when the electrical charge occurs when an egg and sperm come together? The spark of creation is just that -- the ignition of Source creation energy creating new life. The soul lives in the heart, and if there's no heart yet, there's nowhere to live. Once the heart is built, the heartbeat is the soul coming in. 

From there, the soul is in and out until birth.

Why is there an umbilical cord? For physical reasons, such as nourishing and keeping alive the growing baby, but it’s also a spiritual cord anchoring the soul back to the physical vessel.

This spiritual umbilical cord actually remains throughout your physical life.
posts.title: When Does the Soul Enter the Body?

posts.body:
We are told that pregnancy is when a woman’s egg is fertilized and it grows into a baby, which is born about nine months later.

This is true, but it’s not all there is about pregnancy.

Pregnancy is a spiritual process where a woman acts as a spiritual anchor for an incoming soul. This is a highly spiritual practice which has lost most of it's sacredness over time. 

There are so many ceremonial aspects to this process. For example, the would-be mother and father could each go out into nature to connect with the incoming souls considering incarnation. 

Upon pregnancy, the mother could commune with the incoming soul out in nature. She could hear the baby's name (yes, soul's often have name preferences!).  

The process of pregnancy itself would include nurturing the body, mind and spirit throughout the entire experience. 

Nearing birth, a union of community as the community of guardians comes together for the passing of the torch ceremony (See Who Are Your Guardians article for more detail). This would include sacred music of the land, chants, prayers, etc. 

During the entirety of pregnancy, the mother's responsibility is to not only safe-keep the growing body, but to act as a constant and continuous bridge for the baby’s soul to come and go.

The mother is bridging the spiritual realms to the physical world. It is a sacred act.
posts.title: What Pregnancy Truly Is

posts.body:
What I have seen in the Records is very different from what many people have been taught: there is no punishment from Source for suicide or abortion.

I have never, literally never, seen judgement toward any soul for these acts. Source is unconditional love, which literally means – NO conditions.

Zero.

You will not go to hell.

You will be understood, loved and accepted.

You are not insulting God/Source. You will not be judged. There’s nothing to forgive because you didn’t do anything wrong.

You may have thoughts that this is ridiculous because of the very strong opinions that humans and religions have regarding these topics. While that is a conversation all its own, it doesn’t erase the truth: Source is only unconditional love and that will always, and forever more, mean: no conditions.

There is nothing you have done, are doing or will do that will make you unworthy or unlovable.

Period.

And the most beautiful part of all of that is that we can’t mess this up. We’ll still be worthy and lovable no matter what we do, think, say, or feel. You don’t have to agree. This will still be true.

[I’ve helped many people who’ve struggled with self-judgment and judgment of others regarding these two topics. If this resonates and you’d like support, please feel free to reach out for a session. Peace is possible.

There is also a free mediation on my website regarding the Life Review.  This can be a really helpful first step toward processing these emotions so we continue to carry them.]
posts.title: No Conditions: What the Records Show About Source, Judgment, and Forgiveness

posts.body:
If you’re struggling to feel joy, then the concept of “follow your joy” may feel useless. Instead, follow your curiosities. Follow feelings of inspiration.



Feel suddenly inspired to walk a different path or drive a different road? Try it.

When we allow ourselves to explore curiosity and inspiration, we allow the door to joy to open more and more, since both curiosity and inspiration will naturally create those pathways.

This can also help people who struggle to know or remember what they like, who they are or what they want to do. It's okay to not remember these things or to have answers. Following your curiosity or something that inspires you will lead you directly to it.
posts.title: When “Follow Your Joy” Doesn’t Work

posts.body:
In Akashic Record readings, specifically when looking at other lifetimes, sometimes part of our soul is still upset about how a lifetime ended or how it went. I call this a soul-bit because part of our soul is focused somewhere else. These soul-bits can be stuck, fixated on a scenario, and it needs help by 1) getting its attention off the scenario, 2) helping it process what occurred, 3) showing it how life has still gone on and you’re okay, and 4) allowing it to reintegrate at its own pace.

Why does this matter?

These soul-bits show us where we’re currently experiencing issues in our life that we may not enjoy. If a part of the soul hasn’t moved on from that fear, injustice, etc. then you will see struggle in those areas in your current life as well.

Not all issues that we experience come from these struggling soul-bits, as often play a large part as well in our life expression.

Interested to know if you have soul-bits that are distracted somewhere else? Consider booking a session.
posts.title: Soul-bits

posts.body:
These are not the same thing. 

As I have been shown, knowledge and wisdom are the two angels on your shoulders. 

Knowledge can only be given from what currently exists and comes from others. Books, podcasts, teachers, etc. 

Wisdom comes only from Source. It is real-time answers to life’s problems, how-to steps for your life, and more. 

Knowledge is limited; wisdom is infinite.

Knowledge can be attained by listening to others or our ego, since the ego can only help us using past experiences (also known as, knowledge). 

Wisdom comes when we are connected to Source. And we have to listen for it. It’s a softer voice. It’s always what you need. 

(See Soul vs Ego: What's Really Happening? for an interesting comparison!)
posts.title: Knowledge Comes From the World. Wisdom Comes From Somewhere Else.

posts.body:
The Soul Knows. The Ego Remembers.

Contrary to popular thought, the ego isn’t in and of itself bad. What isn’t helpful is when it’s out of balance and in the driver’s seat of your life. 

The ego is a tool for experiencing this world and taking in perceptions as information regarding this life experience. The ego is willing to help you, but it only has access to knowledge, which is all past-based only. Meaning, you learned it in your past from someone else or an experience you had in the past that you don’t want to repeat, so the ego keeps you feeling worried so you don’t repeat it. 

The soul has direct access to the wisdom of Source and shares it with you to help you in life. The soul knows your plan for this life and tries to steer you in the right direction, but it can get pretty difficult if ego is driving the car of your life. 

Both want to help you and both use two very different means to achieve that end. 

You could also consider the soul and the ego as the angel and devil on the shoulders. The classic epitome of the perceived good versus evil, since most people are fed the belief that our ego is worth destroying. 

But if we want to destroy a part of ourselves, we will be at war with ourselves because the ego is part of the human experience. We are not here to transcend or outgrow it, but to ensure it stays in its place and is the tool we need it to be when we need it. 

The soul is the most important relationship you will ever have, next to Source. 

(See How to Hear Your Soul: 3 Ways if you struggle to feel connected or feel you can’t hear it!)
posts.title: Ego vs. Soul: What’s Actually Happening?

posts.body:
Tool # 1



The way I learned to hear my soul was to ignore it. 



Yeah, sounds completely counterintuitive. 



But that’s what I did. I think we all do that here and there, or always, depending on where we are on the path. And guess what? 



That’s okay. 



We’re ready when we’re ready and not a minute sooner. 



Specifically speaking, how did I hear my soul if I ignored it? When coming to a small decision, I’d think about my choices and there were usually a couple options. I’d hear these more prevalent thoughts (harder to ignore), but then I’d hear one softer voice that was very brief. 



I’d choose the louder voice and make the decision. 



Bad decision. 



Later after the decision, I suddenly could see the get the other option would have saved me this and that, I wouldn’t have such and such happen, etc. 



I began to get really frustrated with myself. Time after time, and time and time again, I kept listening to the louder thoughts. Sometimes the soft voice was so soft it would just disappear from my mind almost instantly. 



So, I began to put effort into differentiating what I was hearing. I began to bring focus to that softer voice, and one at a time, began making decisions from what it suggested. 



It worked. 



This built trust, and that trust grew each time I listened. 



This voice of my soul began to grow louder and louder and easier to hear over time. 



I began to notice patterns, such as, if I ignored my soul, then it would nag at me. 



Time and time again when I’d ignore it that I would be shown how it was right, and how I was right with it all along when I’d listen.



So when it nags now, there’s no denying it and I follow it. It 100% always led me the right direction. 



May not always be what you want, but it will be what you need. And you’ll feel better later once you see the clear picture, which always comes. 



There are endless ways to hear your soul, but if you don't already have a pattern of hearing it, just know that it's a quiet voice at first. Once we identify it, we'll begin to recognize how it feels in the body when we hear it and learn to trust it. 



Tool 2:



Get out a journal, ground and shield, and meditate for a moment. When you feel grounded, write out some questions using your dominant hand on the right side of the paper (or left, if you're left-hand dominant). 



And with the non-dominant hand, answer the questions with whatever information comes through. Do not judge what is coming through. 



Tool 3:



Sit outside, ground and shield, and meditate for a moment. Keep a journal with a pen or pencil nearby. When you feel grounded, sit with a blank piece of white or gold paper, or a solid white plate, and stare at the paper or plate. 



This is giving your mind something to do. You want your busy mind to focus on this. 



"What do you want me to do?" the mind will ask.



"Focus on this," you say.



"But it's just a blank paper or plate," the mind may whine.



"Focus on it."



The mind will comply. 



Keeping the mind preoccupied with a job helps to let other parts of the self speak up. You may get sudden insights. Do NOT judge the insights. Just write them down.



The goal is to get OUT of the pattern of knee-jerk responses where we judge a thought or idea too fast. Most of the time, our soul or Source will not always have the most logical steps for us to take, but when we listen, we understand later how perfect it was.



***



Struggling to hear your soul? Consider a session where we can see how your soul is feeling, what it wants, if there's anything it wants you to know, and where it wants to go in life. (Note: It may not be what you think!)



Also consider some of the free meditations as they can help you secure your shields (easier to keep out telepathic noise when you're trying to hear yourself!) among other benefits.
posts.title: How to Hear Your Soul: 3 Ways to Start

posts.body:
What is the Golden Age?

You may have heard this term circulating around the internet. 

But what the Akashic Records have taught is that it is different from these other definitions. 

The Golden Age is not a Light or a Dark age. We've been in a cycle of Light and Dark ages for millions of years. Source has decided to take a different path, called the Golden Age, and it is unique. 

We are returning to what existence was like before time was created -- before duality -- called the Time Before Time.

This does mean that the dark side with fade and go away permanently. I was shown it would take a couple generations to fully enter this Golden Age (to truly see a stark difference to current times).

We don't need duality anymore. We don't have to have pain to grow anymore. We are capable of learning and growing through curiosity, peace and inspiration.
posts.title: We're Entering the Golden Age

posts.body:
We're human.

And in being human, we have an ego and a soul both trying to help us. (See Soul vs Ego for more details!) 

One of our human experiences includes attachment. 

Attachment can occur with anything. It can be a person, place, thing, outcome, process, trajectory, path, idea, belief, etc. 

The ego is a big influence for attachment. (The ego is not bad, that's not what I'm meaning here.) Ego utilizes attachment like an anchor for safety. The Soul utilizes ever-flowing wisdom as an anchor for safety. 

Attachment is a part of life and isn't, in and of itself, bad; however, it can lead to stagnation, disappointment and dead-ends when we can't allow ourselves to shift out of it. 

Sometimes, we think we're attached to one thing, but it's really another. We might think we're attached to the goal of motherhood, but we're actually attached to the process or avenue of how we get there. 

When we're attached to a specific means to an outcome, for example, we're actually gripping too hard. Imagine holding onto a rope that represents what you believe is the best possible way for something to unfold. If you believe that this is the one and only possibility to get what you want, you'll grip it hard. When we grip something hard, it makes it immoveable. 

And when life tries to move it anyway, friction is created. That friction becomes pain — like rope burn — not because the outcome is wrong, but because the grip is too tight to allow movement.

The Akashic Records will see this process and encourage you to loosen the grip. This doesn't mean that the outcome will not occur, it may or may not, but when we loosen the grip on how something manifests, we allow ALL forms of manifestation to come toward us and bring us what we want.

Most times, our manifestations come in forms we wouldn't always have guessed would be the path that worked. Our job isn't to always know the path, but to leave enough space so it can move and form around us. 

The Records do not confirm if things will or will not work. They do see if a current trajectory is looking a certain way, but it's still not a guarantee as this is a co-creative universe. We are always creating with Source and others at all times. 

The future can be influenced by our choices and what we choose to co-create. The Records will be clear about how to better influence different outcomes, if that's possible. 

In some cases, the soul wants to go another direction or take another path to the same destination you want to go. The goal is to loosen the grip so the other paths can reveal themselves. 

Struggling to allow a release of the grip? Consider booking a session where we can focus specifically on helping you feel safe during this process, or consider joining the Mentorship program where you can also get the support of community (We've all been through it!).
posts.title: Attachment to Outcome

posts.body:
Discernment has always been one of humanity’s most important abilities.

We use it constantly — to interpret situations, assess people, navigate relationships, and determine what feels true or false.

But discernment is only as clear as the lens through which we perceive.

Our fears, wounds, conditioning, beliefs, hopes, and past experiences all shape how we interpret reality.

Over time, humanity’s ability to discern clearly has become deeply distorted. We lost connection to ourselves, to each other, and to Source. We lost sight of how interconnected life truly is.

And in many ways, that distortion was reinforced intentionally — through fear, manipulation, disconnection, and systems that pull us further away from our own inner knowing.

But we are entering an era where discernment must be recalibrated.

As artificial intelligence continues to grow and information becomes increasingly difficult to verify, the ability to clearly discern truth from distortion will become more important than ever.

This requires more than intellect.

It requires inner alignment.

It requires clearing fear, outdated beliefs, emotional distortions, and inherited perceptions that interfere with our ability to perceive clearly.

As we recalibrate ourselves, we strengthen our inner compass.

And through that compass, we become more aware, sovereign, grounded, and connected to Source.

If you feel disconnected from yourself, your intuition, your guides, or Source, consider exploring my free meditations or booking a session to support the recalibration of your inner compass.
posts.title: Entering the Era of Discernment

posts.body:
The heart chakra across the chest is the first heart chakra, then we have a second one higher up to the collar bone. 

The higher heart is the second heart chakra and deals a lot with the higher desires of the soul, its goals and wants.

Is it any surprise that we have two heart chakras? 

Two back bones, two sides of the body, two of each chakra (front and back of the body, or left and right of the body), etc.
posts.title: We Have Two Heart Chakras

posts.body:
It may sound silly.

But we have two backbones.

The first is our spine and it protects the body.

The second is our sternum and it protects the heart.

Those within the Records see things differently than we do. Our sternum is directly related to the heart and it deserves the same respect as our spine. The sternum has fibrous materials on the inside that talk to the heart in ways that we don’t quite understand.

Think of the sternum as a shield and your heart as the sword (not for violence, of course) of truth, change and authenticity.

When someone hits a shield in battle, the entire body feels it. There is a vibration that sets off to the rest of the body. When people speak to us, it waves through the body.

Lately, I've been helping folks clean off their sternum and have been shown its direct correlation and connection to our collar bones, shoulders and spine. This is our crystalline armor.
posts.title: We Have TWO Backbones

posts.body:
A lot of people confuse a healing journey with the natural process of spiritual and emotional growth.

The spiritual community is full of “10 ways to fix this,” “how to heal that,” “why you’re blocked,” “what wound is showing up,” and on and on.

And yes — healing matters.

Humanity has come out of a long, dark reality where victim-mentality, disconnection, and inherited patterns were often all we knew. Looking honestly at ourselves, our lineages, our patterns, and our pain was not something many people were taught to do.

So in many ways, this new awareness is beautiful.

But if we are not careful, the pendulum can swing too far the other way.

We can begin over-taking responsibility.

We can stop letting ourselves be human.

We can try to heal ourselves out of ever making mistakes.

We can start believing every hard feeling means there is another wound to excavate.

We can turn healing into a loop we never get permission to leave.

And that was never the point.

This is a reminder of the middle, balanced lane.

Yes, we take responsibility.

Yes, we look at ourselves.

Yes, we heal what is ready to be healed.

But we also let go of the stories that keep old expectations and perceptions locked in place.

And then we live in the new now we have created.

A lot of people forget the live part.

There is a deeper truth here:

We were always meant to continuously evolve spiritually, emotionally, relationally, and energetically.

But evolution was not originally designed as a burden.

The looping feeling of “I have to keep healing things” can come from many places, including:

Addiction to healing.

Control of outcome.

Attachment to outcome.

People pleasing.

Self-loathing.

The belief that we are still not good enough.

For many, the “healing journey” has become an identity.

And when healing becomes an identity, it can become difficult to stop.

We get so used to processing, clearing, searching, and fixing that we forget how to live in the present. We forget what to do with ourselves when there is finally space.

Our natural evolution was designed to move with the ebb and flow of nature.

There is time to work.

There is time to play.

There is time to integrate.

There is time to rest.

Even nature shows us this.

In summer, many animals are active in the morning, rest during the heat of the day, and become active again when the evening cools.

Work. Rest. Work.

The seasons show us the same rhythm.

Spring: planting, cleaning, beginning.

Summer: tending, maintaining, expanding.

Fall: slowing down, harvesting, releasing.Winter: resting, sleeping, restoring.

When we align with nature’s rhythms, we begin to remember our own.

You can take responsibility for a mistake without needing to dig for the root of why you feel terrible for making it.

You can grow without constantly dissecting yourself.

You can evolve without turning your humanity into a problem to solve.

You will know when it is time to work because Source makes it clear.

And as you grow, as your intuition clears and strengthens, you learn to discern the difference between Source, yourself, others, fear, conditioning, and old patterns.

So take a break if you have not taken one in a while.

And if you are in the middle of deep work right now, keep your chin up and look for the places where rest is still available.

This was never meant to be an unending marathon.

Take rest, loves.
posts.title: Healing Journey vs Evolution — Clarifying the Two

posts.body:
Just because something feels good doesn't mean it should be invited in.



Throughout the entire spiritual community, people feel connected to animal spirits. “Owl is my spirit animal,” or “Buffalo is my protective spirit animal.”

In some cultures, such as the Bwiti tribe in Gabon, Africa, cat spirits are used to rescue souls that need retrieval because they’re known as the fastest spirit animal.

There is a place for the spirits of animals to help us.

But.

The dark side also knows this.

Just like with any being, we still need to be discerning even when approached by animal spirits that want to support us.

I have seen entities use the proximity animal spirits are granted to get close to humans. I’ve also seen them mask as animal spirits to get close to humans and sometimes, come into the human body by invitation.

I had to remove an entity recently that was embedded half-way in the back of a client because it had been invited in. The client had felt the big wings and believed that it was an eagle spirit. 

The dark side is not above pretending to be or masking as an animal spirit. But they will prey on naivety that you may or may not know that they're not supposed to come into your vessel.

A human may feel that there’s a being near them with great wings and they feel “nice.” The brain may automatically fill in “this is safe” without further question.

Word of caution: NO BEING HAS ANY BUSINESS COMING INTO YOUR VESSEL.

There is no need to “embody” any spirit animal. They will not ask you to do so.

As the saying goes: The wind beneath your wings.

Key word: beneath. Beneath your wings. Not inside and you're one.

Support only. Not enmeshment.
posts.title: Use Discernment With Spirit Animals - Here's Why

posts.body:
The Akashic Records often teach the process of letting go. 

Letting go of the outcome, letting go of the process, letting go of control, etc. 

The sentence "What's coming is going" is really helpful during periods of integration as well. I often tell folks after big sessions that they get a free pass from looking at their "stuff" for a bit, and to just let "what's coming is going." 

Why is this helpful?

After big movement or releases, emotions can up come. Those who want to be responsible for their emotions may latch on to these emotions and think they have to address them, not realizing that the emotions are coming up because they addressed another aspect they were associated with. In this case as well, these emotions are coming up and leaving. 

If we allow them to leave, they'll leave. 

This is the power of this practice. Not everything needs our attention. The real question is discerning when to place our attention and when not to.
posts.title: "What's coming is going."

posts.body:
This post is not going to be filled with what you typically hear regarding war. 

When we discuss the battle of good and evil, light and dark, positive and negative, we have to understand that war plays out differently than in the news. 

There are a set of laws created by Source that both sides must follow. 

You may have heard that there is a war for the spirit, or the mind, or perception, etc. 

But what if perception is truly at the root? 

If you can influence someone’s perception, you can ultimately exert control. 

That may sound a little harsh, but you may have also heard “What you think you believe.” I’m going to take it back one step further to what you perceive you think. 

If the way you perceive an event or person can be manipulated (which is common in all forms of media, even alternative media), then what we think about the experience or person then shapes what we feel and thereby what actions we take. 

Perception is the number one thing both sides of any war want to control.

By influencing the perception of others, one side may be able to enlist more soldiers, or get more supplies, create more alliances, etc. 

Both sides also get more focused energy the more attention they get. While there is no such thing as bad publicity, energy flows where attention goes, and oftentimes, simply getting enough awful attention for evil doings can create an immense flow of energy into the prolongation of activities. 

The “negative” side thrives on influence and using influence on how you perceive the world at large, and your own personal life. 

Our perception is a key ingredient in manifestation. What we perceive we think, what we think we feel, what we feel we believe, what we believe we create. 

So why would the control or influence of perception become a pivotal piece in any war? It’s how you get others to manifest on your behalf, how you gain power, and how you get the ability to do what you want. 

I'll state it again: It is possible to get others to manifest on your behalf. And it's possible to trick, coerce, manipulate and force others into doing so. 

To not fall into this accidentally:

Observe your perceptions. Observe where your attention goes, and continually bring it back to feelings of gratitude, grace, joy, and trust that everything will be okay. 

Be the change you want to see in the world. 

Create the new.

Live in the new creation you've built. 

Ask Source to take care of the rest.

Co-create with Source.

Everything will be okay. 

Source does have a divine plan, no matter what it looks like out in the world. This is a small time in the blip of infinity.
posts.title: What Sides of Any Spiritual War Want to Control Most

posts.body:
I was in the Akashic/Soul Records one day when a person's guardians approached. I could see each of them clearly and began introducing them. (My client wanted to know who they were because they didn't feel they knew them or could hear them.) 

I suddenly got to a lovely being who, at first glance, I deemed as one without a gender. I've met these beings before. 

"I am not genderless," the guardian said. "I am the perfect balance of masculine and feminine."

That's when it hit me -- even God/Source (insert your preferred name here) is the perfect balance of masculine and feminine. While I already knew this, I too thought there could be a genderless option of beings. This is an impossibility. 

It is not the absence of gender but the completion of perfect balance between masculine and feminine. 

Not gender-less. Gender-full.
posts.title: Genderless Beings -- Real or Fake?

posts.body:
Living contracts are not in the same category as other contracts. They're alive, often carefully monitored and affect families, groups and lineages. They actively impact those within the confines of its wording. 

It is possible to remove certain individuals from this and re-file for those who choose not to get out of it. 

Living contracts actively affect one or more person, usually causing generational impact or societal grouping impact.

(An example of societal grouping impact: There are specific cities that have living contracts that include and incorporate all the residents of said area. This is an in-depth discussion for another time, and more than cities can be affected.)

Oftentimes, a living generational contract will affect the entire lineage, but we are given the opportunity to remove you, your kids, grandkids, and pull it back, one generation at a time, off those who are supportive of it being removed. Not all ancestors are open to the removal of a living contract at the time it's offered. 

In this case, we remove whoever we can and re-file the contract as active but with people removed as if they were never a part of it in the first place. 

Those still on the contract will continue to experience its effects, while those removed will be free of it.

Living contracts often look like books that feel as if they're living and breathing.

Curious what contracts are influencing your life? Come check out a session! 

Search my other articles regarding contracts if you'd like more information. 

Contract work is a specialty of mine within the Akashic Records and I can speak extensively on the topic. 

There are many different types of contracts and each one is uniquely addressed and removed. There is no one-size fits all approach to this topic, which is why it's vastly more complex than most people realize.
posts.title: What are Living Contracts?

posts.body:
Yes. 

Not all ancestors are all-loving or peaceful... for now. Some are perfectly happy to see suffering in the line as long as they don’t have to deal with it. 

So what happens? 

During sessions (or medicine spaces for some folks), specific generational issues will be traced back to someone in the line. That soul will be given the opportunity to take responsibility for their part of the issue at hand. 

If it’s too much for them to hold, they’re offered help. 

If they make ill-wishes for the line and clearly have dark intentions for the line, occasionally, it’ll be suggested to cut them out of the lineage from causing further harm. 

This is a last resort, not done just cause they made a mistake. Everyone makes mistakes, but some souls do wish harm to their lineage and activity participate in doing so.

Those cut out can still make amends when they've grown spiritually and emotionally.
posts.title: Can You Cut Out Ancestors?

posts.body:
Within Akashic Record readings, I have been afforded the ability to check-in on physical healing aspects for folks. Interestingly enough, I often come across electrical deficiencies within folks. 

In those cases, the Records will put an energetic meter, so to speak, on a main artery in the left or right leg, which will pulse rapidly, providing an electrical current/charge to the system. 

We are electrical beings by nature, and this is a key note regarding why grounding is so beneficial and important. Grounding is a natural way to "charge" our electrical systems naturally, and we need a charged electrical system for optimal health. 

When we have a low electrical charge, we find ourselves routinely sluggish, more brain fog, and slower to heal. 

We can ground with both feet on the Earth or both hands touching a rooted plant, like a tree for at least ten minutes a day.

Give it a try for 30 days. You may find your sleep improve, more clarity and mental sharpness, and feeling better overall.
posts.title: We are Electrical Beings

posts.body: Yarrow for the cut, plantain for the sting, mullein for the cough — the pharmacy grows along every path here. Notes from ten seasons of gathering — demo piece.
posts.title: A field guide to roadside medicine

posts.body:
Every system is perfectly designed to get the results it gets.

Most networks feed you to an algorithm tuned to maximize attention, harvest fear, and drive consumption that temporarily comforts the dis-ease of disconnection — chronic suffering that current systems rely on to survive. The results we're getting are the results those systems were built for.

Lichen is a corrective. Not another place to perform, but one trusted web for the whole of a life: care and healing, work and offerings, the events we gather for, the places we love, and an economy that values what actually holds us together.

This course is a walk through that design — what each part is for, and why it was built the way it was. Take it slowly. Nothing here rewards speed.
posts.title: Why Lichen exists

posts.body:
Most platforms show you who's online whether they meant to be seen or not. Presence becomes surveillance, then pressure, then performance.

Lichen inverts it. Presence lives in exactly one place — a panel you open on purpose — and it's yours to give:

**Around** — a quiet dot when you're here and haven't muted it.
**Present** — a candle you light by hand, when you actually want to be found.

No ambient dots anywhere else. No timestamps. No "last seen." Just an offer, extended deliberately, to the people in your web.

Try lighting your candle when you have room for someone, and snuffing it when you don't. That's the whole practice: availability as a gift you choose to give, not a status you're assigned.
posts.title: Presence is a gift, not a status

posts.body:
**Current-cy** is value that remembers. A transparent ledger, pegged to the dollar, where contribution is recorded and can come back around — including contribution from beyond-human members, because the horse who carries someone's grief is doing real work.

Balances are private to the holder. No leaderboards, by construction — the same anti-gamification stance as trust. Value that remembers doesn't need to be displayed to be real.

**Care** is the other half. Your care team assembles by mutual consent: either person can offer or ask, and the other approves before anything is real. Inside Concierge, the Web of Wellbeing holds the six aspects of a life — mental, physical, social, spiritual, economic, environmental — and only your active care team can see what you choose to share there.

Healing the world starts with ourselves. This is the infrastructure for doing it together.
posts.title: Current-cy, and care that holds

posts.body:
There are two maps of value, and they don't match.

The first is **actual reciprocity** — a mother's care, an old-growth forest, a paramedic's shift. The second is **priced value** — what the market pays for those same things. Hold them side by side and the gaps are obvious: work that's not compensated, life that's not counted, labor that's underpaid, and a few strands wildly over-paid.

Lichen's algorithm reads both maps and works the largest gap first. Every offer you make — gift, trade, lend, rent, sale, or in-search-of — flows through the Marketplace, the commons where resources are managed collectively. Choosing **Lichen\*** hands the routing to the Economy Algorithm: your contribution goes where it closes the most need, and the story comes back to you.

When you exchange manually, you close the gap that you can see. The algorithm reads the whole web at once and weaves strands together, so nothing — and no one — is wasted.
posts.title: Two maps: the economy in action

posts.body:
Ratings can be farmed. A path through your own relationships can't be faked.

On Lichen there are no follower counts, no leaderboards, no five-star averages to perform for. Instead there are two private gestures:

**Weaving** someone into your mycelium says: I want their doings to flow to me. It implies nothing about trust.

**Trusting** someone is a separate, private signal — person by person, never shown as a count, never ranked. When something surfaces to you with a shield, it's because someone you trust stands behind it.

This is also your safety when things change hands. Browse the whole marketplace, or narrow it to people you trust — or people they trust — and every listing shows your path to the person behind it: "Trusted by Melanie — someone you trust." The mutual friend you'd want before meeting a stranger, built into the ground you walk on.

Quality over quantity, by design.
posts.title: Weaving your web: trust you can't game

posts.body:
Your life isn't lived in silos, so it shouldn't be stored in them.

On Lichen, your care team and your marketplace listings and your calendar and the communities you belong to are all part of one presence. The practitioner you trust can see the appointment. The group planning a work party can find the truck someone is lending. The course you're teaching can hold its own chat, its own calendar, its own cohort.

That integration is the point. Coordination is where most good intentions die — the retreat that never gets scheduled, the help that's offered but never lands, the skill nobody knew was three houses away. A platform that holds the whole of a life can close those gaps.

Everything in one place, because your best life isn't lived in silos — or on a technology platform.
posts.title: Your whole life, in one place

posts.body: What this lesson establishes: the inversion at the root of everything else — that awareness is fundamental rather than emergent, and what changes downstream once that is taken seriously. Bring: the luminaries whose framing you trust most, and the evidence that moved you.
posts.title: Consciousness is not produced by matter

posts.body: What this lesson establishes: participation. Reality responds to attention; measurement is not passive. Bring: the physics you find most honest, and the everyday experiences that make it felt rather than theoretical.
posts.title: The observer and the observed

posts.body: What this lesson establishes: how held belief becomes lived world, individually and collectively. This is the hinge your whole platform rests on: because our beliefs create our reality, changing the system means changing what we believe is possible.
posts.title: Belief creates reality — the mechanism

posts.title: The field: coherence, resonance, entrainment

posts.title: Working with consciousness: individual practice

posts.title: A better future, deliberately made

posts.body:
Lichen asks you to make real choices instead of guessing at defaults you never saw.

Almost everything here is **on by default and switchable off** — one uniform rule across the platform, so you never have to wonder whether this particular corner works differently. What changes is only ever what you choose.

This short course walks the switches: your presence, your location, your calendar, your financial picture, and the assistant. Five minutes now saves you a lot of second-guessing later.
posts.title: What you share, and with whom

posts.body:
Two signals, both yours to give:

**Around** — a quiet dot when you're here. On by default, muted whenever you like.
**Present** — the candle in the top bar. You light it by hand when you actually want to be found.

Presence lives in exactly one place: a panel your network can open. No ambient dots elsewhere, no timestamps, no "last seen." Change either setting in the Mycelium directory.

Presence is a gift, not a status.
posts.title: Presence: around, present, or neither

posts.body:
Your location isn't one switch — it's a ladder, and you set it per audience.

**Hidden · State · County · Area (town) · Exact**

Everyone can be at one level, your mycelium at another, a specific community at a third. Most-specific wins, and at a tie the most private wins. The "Area" rung is deliberate: findable without being pinpointable.

Set it in Profile → Home location → "Who can find you on the map."
posts.title: Where you are: five levels, per audience

posts.body:
Sharing a calendar doesn't mean sharing your life.

Viewers see one of three things: **nothing**, **busy blocks** (no titles), or **full details** — again per audience, most-specific wins. Imported calendars go further: their titles stay yours alone unless you explicitly opt that calendar in.

Find it in Calendar → settings → "Who sees my calendar."
posts.title: Your calendar: busy, or the details

posts.body:
If you're seeking subsidized care, an honest picture of your means is what lets the network route fairly. So Lichen asks for it, and then protects it harder than anything else.

Only **you** and your **active care team** can read it. Not admins. Not other members. Never a score, never public, never compared.

It lives in Concierge → Web of Wellbeing → Financial position, and sharing it is entirely optional.
posts.title: Your financial picture — the most private thing here

posts.body:
The brain icon appears in each section — Home, Marketplace, Calendar, Chat, your shelf. Tapping it asks the assistant to organize what's waiting *in that section only*.

**Consent runs both ways.**

*What your assistant reads for you.* Nothing moves until you tap — no ambient reading, no background summarizing. Each section switches independently, so you can turn the assistant off for Chat and keep it on for Marketplace. Off means that section's data never reaches the assistant at all.

*What other assistants read of you.* When someone you talk with asks their assistant to brief them, it reads recent messages in that conversation — including the ones you wrote. You decide whether that's allowed: **Profile → Notifications → "Let other members' assistants read my messages."** Switch it off and your words stay out of everyone else's briefings. They'll still see that you wrote, and can still read you in the app; only the machine is held back.

In Chat, an assistant that is on receives recent messages from rooms you're already in, summarizes rather than quotes, and is never handed your full history.

Two people, two switches, one conversation. Carbon decides; silicon organizes.
posts.title: The assistant: consent, both ways

posts.body:
Two dials worth knowing:

**Notification preference** (Profile) — in-app only, or email as well, or off entirely.
**Push on this device** (Profile → Notifications) — per device, so your phone can buzz while your laptop stays quiet.

And two things that deliberately never notify: **weaving** someone into your mycelium is silent, and **trusting** them is private. Nobody is told they've been trusted, and no one can see a count.
posts.title: Notifications, and who hears from you
